'''Ciran Ern''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] representative of [[Junction V]] during [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] reign. Though he cooperated with [[Lorian Nod]] for a long time in the scheme involving the [[Annihilator (superweapon)|Annihilator]]. He was killed by Nod for placing an arrest warrant on the former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who betrayed the whole population of his [[Planet/Legends|planet]].
